The '''Dom-Bradden system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Lol sector/Legends|Lol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dom-Bradden/Legends|Dom-Bradden]].
